name: advanced-select
title: Advanced Select
description: A multi-select built from Popover, Command and Badge primitives for choosing tags, members or filters. It adds optional search, removable selection badges, select-all/clear actions, loading, a visible-badge limit and optional creation of new options. Use it when selecting several values; SimpleSelect is the smaller API for one value. This saves rebuilding selection state and badge/search composition in every form.
